'''Stephen Sutton Heir To the Empire''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Stephen Sutton]]
* '''Published:''' March 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)]]
* '''Strategy:''' Heir To the Empire
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PHoth Heir To the Empire Sutton DS 1997.txt |Download]]
